news.description: Connor Riley Moucka  pleaded guilty in Seattle federal court on Wednesday to computer fraud, wire fraud, aggravated identity theft and a related conspiracy over the 2024 breaches of Snowflake customer accounts .   The intrusions reached at least 165 organizations and exposed records belonging to at least 100 million people.
